course_description: This is an advanced interdisciplinary introduction to applied parallel computing on modern supercomputers. It has a hands-on emphasis on understanding the realities and myths of what is possible on the world's fastest machines. We will make prominent use of the {{% resource_link "9a5e5b25-6629-4983-bf1c-bfdfd2337bd0" "Julia Language" %}}, a free, open-source, high-performance dynamic programming language for technical computing.
